sample.review.r1: +60 lb a deadlift ɗina cikin makonni 14 ba tare da rana ɗaya ta ciwon baya ba.

sample.review.r3: Kowane zaman horo yana da bayani da ke jira bayansa. Yanzu na fahimci dalilin da ya sa shirin yake haka.
sample.review.r4: Ban taɓa riƙe barbell ba a da. Bayan watanni takwas na ɗaga ninki biyu na nauyin jikina.
sample.workout.deadlift.body: Sanda a kan tsakiyar ƙafa, ka ja ta har ta matse, sannan ka tura ƙasa daga gare ka.
sample.workout.deadlift.title: Shirya deadlift
sample.workout.row.body: Ka yi doguwar ja, ka fara da ƙafafu. Ka riƙe sauri ɗaya a kowace tazara.
sample.workout.row.title: Daidaita sauri a injin tuƙi
sample.workout.squat.body: Ka matse tsakiyar jikinka, ka zauna tsakanin ƙugunka, ka tashi kamar yadda ka sauka.
sample.workout.squat.title: Squat na baya, abin da nake dubawa
sample.workout.swings.body: Ƙugu yana fizgowa, hannaye riƙo kawai suke yi. Ka dakatar da saitin idan kettlebell ya fara karkata.
sample.workout.swings.title: Swing na kettlebell

sample.nutri.dish.everyday.2: Abincin dare na iyali da kowa ke so.

sample.nutri.dish.everyday.4: Karin kumallon mako guda, an shirya shi lokaci ɗaya.
sample.nutri.dish.everyday.5: Kasko ɗaya, kuma za ka iya ƙara shi ya isa duk teburin.
sample.nutri.dish.performance.0: Farantin bayan horo da nake ba kusan kowa. Ka ninka shi ranar Lahadi.
sample.nutri.dish.performance.1: Mintuna biyar, kusan 40 g na furotin. Don safiyar da kake horo da wuri.
sample.nutri.dish.performance.2: Omega-3 da karbs masu narkewa a hankali a tire ɗaya. Sau biyu a mako a lokacin gasa.
sample.nutri.dish.performance.3: Sinadarin ƙarfe don lokutan horo masu nauyi. Karin kumallon da aka fi so a ci da dare.
sample.nutri.dish.performance.4: Ana shirya shi tun da dare, don haka zaman horo na ƙarfe 6 na safe ma yana samun karin kumallo.
sample.nutri.dish.performance.5: Abincin rana huɗu a lokaci ɗaya. Akwatin da yawancin abokan hulɗa ke ci gaba da yi.
sample.nutri.dish.plant.0: Kwanon da ke sa masu shakka su canza ra’ayi. Ka matse tofu ɗin, yana da muhimmanci.
sample.nutri.dish.plant.1: Mai arha, mai sauri, kuma yana jure firiza. Amsata ga "Babu komai a gida".
sample.nutri.dish.plant.2: Fiber da launuka don daren Talata.
sample.nutri.dish.plant.3: Fiye da 30 g na furotin daga tsirrai. Yana da daɗi a sanyaye washegari.
sample.nutri.dish.plant.4: Kasko ɗaya don karin kumallo na makare, ƙwai idan ka so.
sample.nutri.dish.plant.5: Karin kumallon mako guda ya kammala cikin mintuna goma.

sample.nutri.dish.steady.2: Ƙaraƙau da ɗanɗano, ba tare da nauyi a ciki ba.
sample.nutri.dish.steady.3: Karin kumallon da ke sa safiya ta kasance cikin natsuwa.
sample.nutri.dish.steady.4: Tukunya ɗaya ranar Lahadi, abincin rana har zuwa Alhamis.

sample.nutri.meal.everyday.0.1: Rana ta biyu ta girkin ranar Lahadi.
sample.nutri.meal.everyday.0.2: Yara ne suka mulmula ƙwallon nama. Lokaci ninki biyu, nishaɗi ninki biyu.
sample.nutri.meal.everyday.1.0: Ƙwai biyu, gasasshen burodin alkama, tumatir a gefe.
sample.nutri.meal.everyday.1.1: Daga firiza bayan na dawo da dare. Shinkafar jiya.
sample.nutri.meal.everyday.1.2: Harissa a gefe ga waɗanda ba sa son yaji.
sample.nutri.meal.performance.0.0: Kashi ɗaya bisa huɗu na furotin ɗin yini kafin ƙarfe takwas.
sample.nutri.meal.performance.0.1: Abincin rana daga kaskon Lahadi. Rabin ganye a gefe, tafin hannu na kaza, dunƙulen hannu na shinkafa.
sample.nutri.meal.performance.0.2: Karbs awa ɗaya kafin ɗaga nauyi. Kitse daga baya.
sample.nutri.meal.performance.0.3: Furotin ɗin yau ya cika. Haka kuma gobe.
sample.nutri.meal.performance.1.0: An yi shi jiya da dare, an ci shi a cikin jirgin ƙasa.
sample.nutri.meal.performance.1.1: Akwati na uku cikin huɗu. Har yanzu yana da kyau.
sample.nutri.meal.performance.1.2: Sinadarin ƙarfe a ranar hutu kafin lokacin horo mai nauyi.
sample.nutri.meal.plant.0.0: Madarar waken soya da chia. Yana jirana lokacin da na tashi.
sample.nutri.meal.plant.0.1: Na matse tofu na mintuna ashirin a wannan karon. Ya cancanta.
sample.nutri.meal.plant.0.2: Ciye-ciyen yamma da nake ba yawancin abokan hulɗa.
sample.nutri.meal.plant.0.3: Na dafa ninki biyu, rabo huɗu a cikin firiza.
sample.nutri.meal.plant.1.0: Karin kumallo na makare a ranar Lahadi, babu gaggawa.
sample.nutri.meal.plant.1.1: Albasar tsami daga kwalbar da ke cikin firji.
sample.nutri.meal.plant.1.2: Na yi biyu, ɗaya don abincin rana na gobe.

sample.nutri.meal.steady.0.2: Ya isa ya kai ni har abincin dare.
sample.nutri.meal.steady.0.3: Bok choy a cikin kasko ɗaya na mintuna uku na ƙarshe.
sample.nutri.meal.steady.1.0: Da sauri, kuma yana riƙe ni har zuwa abincin rana.
sample.nutri.meal.steady.1.2: Ƙarin wake don fiber. An gama shirya abincin rana.

sample.nutri.review.n1: Tsarin farko da na riƙe har bayan mako na biyu. Yanzu ina girki sau uku a mako kuma ina cin abinci mai kyau duk kwana bakwai.
sample.nutri.review.n2: Ya ba ni kuzari a marathon ɗina na farko ba tare da gajiya ta karya ni ko sau ɗaya ba. Tsarin makon tseren kamar zinare ne.
sample.nutri.review.n3: Ana karanta kowane abinci da na rubuta, kuma bayanan gajeru ne masu amfani. Babu jin laifi game da abinci, ko kaɗan.
sample.nutri.review.n4: Na rage 9 kg cikin watanni biyar kuma har yanzu ina cin taliya a ranar Juma’a.

sample.nutri.station.fridge: Furotin da aka dafa a saman shiryayye, kayan lambu da aka yanka a daidai ido. Abin da ka fara gani shi kake ci.
sample.nutri.station.pantry: Hatsi, shinkafa, wake da gwangwani, kowane tulu da alama. Ma'ajiya cike na nufin abincin dare ba zai zama na saya ba.
sample.nutri.station.stove: Kasko ɗaya yawancin dare: soya furotin, sannan kayan lambu a cikin abin da ya rage.
sample.nutri.station.oven: Abincin dare a faranti ɗaya na tanda: komai a kai, minti ashirin da biyar, abu ɗaya da za a wanke.
sample.nutri.station.prepIsland: Shirin Lahadi yana farawa a nan: yanka na mako, auna rabo, cika kwanuka.
sample.nutri.station.kitchenTable: Inda muke zama mu ci abinci, babu waya. Abinci yana ɗaukar minti ashirin, ba biyar ba.
trainer.activityEmptySelf: Babu abin da aka saka tukuna. Rubuta gudu, rubutu ko hoto, kuma mambobi za su gan shi a nan.
sample.activity.run.title: Gudu a hankali, zone 2
sample.activity.run.body: Ina aikata abin da nake koyarwa: saurin da za ka iya magana har ƙarshe.
sample.activity.note.title: Makon sassauci
sample.activity.note.body: A wannan makon kowa zai rage zuwa kashi biyu cikin uku na mafi nauyin saitinsa. Hutu sashe ne na shirin, ba hutu daga gare shi ba.
sample.nutri.activity.prep.title: Shirin Lahadi
sample.nutri.activity.prep.body: Kwanuka goma sha biyu cikin minti casa'in: furotin biyu, hatsi uku, faranti ɗaya na gasasshen kayan lambu. Shirin yana aiki ne kawai idan abinci ya shirya.
sample.nutri.activity.walk.title: Tafiya bayan abincin dare
sample.nutri.activity.walk.body: Minti talatin a ƙafa bayan abincin dare. Ya fi yawancin ƙarin magunguna kyau ga sukarin jini.
